All round-1 concerns verified resolved: conflict markers cleared, is_known_mjs_path correctly covers .github/extensions/ and scripts/ trees, shepherd-lease test now seeds ORDER_WAIT fence on PR1 making the no-removal assertion non-trivial. Lint, typecheck, and unit tests pass. No new concerns.
